source_title: The Nintendo Switch 2 "Choose Your Game" Bundle Drops to $479 at Woot While Supplies Last
source_excerpt:
Don't wait until Black Friday to get a Switch 2 console, get this deal now.
Woot (which is owned by Amazon) just busted out the an excellent Nintendo Switch 2 deal that I was not expecting, even on Black Friday. While supplies last, you can pick up a Nintendo Switch 2 "Choose Your Game" console bundle for just $479 after you apply $40 off coupon code " SAVETOBER ". You must apply this coupon code manually in your shopping cart at the last step before placing your order . Amazon Prime members get free delivery, otherwise add $5 shipping. This is a brand new console with 90-day Woot warranty. I don't think we'll see a better Switch 2 deal during Black Friday.
Nintendo Switch 2 "Choose Your Game Bundle" for $479
Nintendo Switch 2 "Choose Your Game" Console Bundle
This bundle includes the Nintendo Switch 2 console and your choice of either Mario Kart World , Donkey Kong Bananza , or Pokemon Pokopia . All are worth getting, but of the three, Pokemon Pokopia has seen the fewest discounts thus far. This bundle was first launched back in June at a retail price of $499.99. After the Nintendo price hike, the cost went up $549.99. WIth this deal, you're getting it for even less than the original MSRP.
Aside from the choice of three games, several other AAA titles have been released including Pokemon Legends: Z-A, Kirby Air Riders, Hyrule Warriors: Age of Imprisonment, Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave , and more. Zelda: Ocarina of Time is the next hotly anticipated game and it comes out very soon on November 5.
Triple-A ports have also made their way to the Switch 2 console, including Cyberpunk 2077 and Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade , making the Switch 2 a veritable competitor to pricier handheld gaming PCs. The Switch 2 hardware is powerful enough to run these games at a very playable clip, a feat that's impossible on the original Switch's hardware.
Eric Song is the IGN commerce manager in charge of finding the best gaming and tech deals every day. When Eric isn't hunting for deals for other people at work, he's hunting for deals for himself during his free time.
